move verb

Traupman 348

migrō, migrāre, migrāvī, migrātum

verb, first conjugation

move house, change one’s residence, move away

Where one moves to is in + acc., or the bare accusative of a town name: Vejōs migrāre; out of a house is ēmigrāre domō.

Other words

  • dēmigrō, dēmigrāre — move away, emigrate

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Caes. BG 4.19: dē oppidīs (Lewis & Short); Cic. Agr. 2.42: in illa loca (Lewis & Short)

See also house.
